VARIANT_1_HIGH_CONTRAST.name: High Contrast - Attention Grab
VARIANT_1_HIGH_CONTRAST.description: Bold neon pink background with cyan text

design_specs.additional_elements: Glitch effects, motion lines, exclamation marks
design_specs.target_audience: ADHD viewers who relate to chaos

implementation.text: Extract top 2-3 words from title. Kal/Echo in extreme emotional state.

VARIANT_2_EMOTIONAL.name: Emotional Connection - Relatable
VARIANT_2_EMOTIONAL.description: Warm colors with Kal/Echo's expressive face prominent

design_specs.text_color: Dark text on light background for readability
design_specs.focal_point: Kal/Echo's face showing emotion (confused, panicked, relieved)
design_specs.additional_elements: Emojis if relevant, soft glow, facial expression emphasis

implementation.text: 1-3 words only. Complement the emotion shown.

VARIANT_3_MINIMALIST.name: Minimalist - Clean & Bold
VARIANT_3_MINIMALIST.description: Minimal text, strong focal point, high contrast area

design_specs.background: Solid dark color (#1a1a2e) or stark white
design_specs.target_audience: Users who skim feed quickly, need immediate clarity

implementation.text: 1 word ONLY. Must encapsulate entire concept.

scoring_guidance.best_for_retention: Variant 2 (Emotional) - Most relatable, encourages clicks from right audience
scoring_guidance.recommendation: A/B test all 3: Upload Variant 1 as primary, monitor V2 & V3 in analytics

next_steps: 1. Choose which variant to feature (recommend: Variant 1 for raw CTR)
2. Generate 3 PNG thumbnails from these specs
4. Track CTR for each variant over time
6. Iterate: Winning variant becomes template for future videos
